$comment: The Rock releases the release workflow builds packages for (decision D-release-1). Each package is for one exact Rock (decision 52), so the workflow checks out each ref from SparkDevNetwork/Rock, builds it, writes and verifies every dataset's package for it, and publishes them under packages/v{tag}/rock-{version}/. 'ref' is a release tag once Rock tags the release, or a full commit hash before then. The workflow refuses a ref whose Directory.Build.props has a different version.

releases.$comment: Rock 21.0.2 has no release tag yet. This is develop on 2026-10-21, the commit the packages were last verified on. Change it to the tag "21.0.2" once Rock publishes it.
